title: Embed Kanbus in domain apps and launch Prospectus CRM
description: As a brand operator, I want a dedicated Prospectus CRM and reusable Kanbus components so sales and customer-success work share real Kanbus issues and Virtuus storage. Preserve standalone Kanbus. Papyrus remains a separate app; marketing sites link or submit requests to Prospectus. No Papyrus schema plugin, production deployment, shared Cognito decision, public repository creation, or persistent AWS access grants. Milestones: reusable embedding foundation; local CRM workflow and storage proof; reviewed Amplify delivery setup.
